title: Chapter 1323
text:
In the blink of an eye, the black Mechanical Deity changed its appearance. Countless pieces of flesh grew out from the gaps of the mechanical structure like the roots of a plant, quickly taking root in its enormous body. The original mechanical body seemed to have turned into a skeleton, and the knotted flesh covered it. It turned from a mechanical giant into a biochemical giant.

During the transformation process, the energy fluctuations released by Han Xiao seemed to be magnified at the same time, and the individual energy readings that broke the record were displayed on the radar screens of the various battleships.

At the same time, the bright red blood energy and the golden Mechanical Force arcs intertwined with each other. Like steam, they continuously emitted from the surface of the Mechanical Deity. It was very eye-catching, and the surrounding mechanical army reflected the light, making the battlefield look golden red.

Clottey and the others looked at this scene in shock. They only felt a vague pressure coming at them, and their hearts palpitated, awakening the memories that had been sealed for a long time …

This feeling was like the life level pressure they had experienced when they were young. It had been a long time since they had entered the Beyond Grade A realm!

"What the hell is this? I've never seen a Mechanical Deity of this type! "Oulou's expression changed drastically.

"I've never seen other Mechanics use it either. It's most likely Black Star's self-created technology. It seems to have the shadow of the Polar Channel Flow. It should be some kind of explosive method … It doesn't look simple. Be careful!"

Clottey's expression was extremely solemn.

On the other side, Manison also opened his eyes wide in shock.

"What kind of move is this …"

As a veteran Mechanic, he actually did not understand at first and was very confused.

This does not look like something a Mechanic should do!

What kind of things does Black Star usually research?

However, after taking a closer look, Manison suddenly noticed some details.

"There seems to be traces of Felon technology … Could Black Star have reverse-trained Felons?"

Manison was a little confused.

Just as everyone was shocked, the space around the Mechanical Deity trembled, and an energy ring suddenly exploded where the Mechanical Deity was. When they looked again, the huge body of the Mechanical Deity suddenly disappeared from where it was, leaving behind a series of electric traces. It had already arrived in front of Clottey and the others. It was as though it had teleported, and its size did not slow down its speed at all.

A wave of blue psionic energy swept up by the halberd, as if it had pierced through the dark curtain of the universe and instantly arrived before Clottey's eyes!

Getta Ripple Fist – Vortex Blade!

At this critical moment, Clottey took a deep breath and absorbed the dark energy that filled the universe. It rolled over like a tide and collided with the halberd blade.

Bang!!

The next moment, a circular shockwave suddenly burst out from the point of collision!

Clottey's figure shot out like a cannonball. Like a beam of light, he instantly pierced through a row of battleships, leaving behind a series of openings.

In just one exchange, the National Pillar of the Red Empire, the Dark Emperor, was sent flying!

The many direct Beyond Grade As immediately reacted. They did not have the time to be shocked and immediately used their own methods to cooperate with each other and surround Han Xiao. The battle instantly began!

At the same time, Clottey's serious voice sounded in the team channel.

"Don't fight him head-on!"

Clottey finally stopped his momentum and ran back to the battlefield. His entire body was covered in a crystal-yellow prismatic shield, which was now filled with cracks.

This shield was not his skill but a protective Universal Treasure that he had activated. It had extremely strong defensive power. Since the three Universal Civilizations had sent them, the direct members, to suppress Black Star, they naturally would not be stingy with their Universal Treasures and gave a few to each direct member.

Although he was not injured, the power of Han Xiao's stab still made Clottey speechless.

Although the defense of this protective Universal Treasure he used was not as strong as the Spacetime Amber, it was still extremely outstanding. If the peak damage did not reach the standard, it could almost be immune to all attacks. Even he would have to charge up for a while before he could break it. He did not expect Han Xiao to shatter it so easily.

Hearing Clottey's reminder, the dozen or so direct Beyond Grade As spread out and surrounded him. The Mechanics summoned their troops, and the Mages also summoned their summoned creatures, covering the sky and restraining Han Xiao. At the same time, Han Xiao's mechanical army also followed and participated in the battle.

Both sides had their human wave tactics, and it immediately turned into a huge chaotic battle.

Han Xiao turned into a Mechanical Deity, and the Mechanical Emperor's Sacred Halberd swung wildly, cutting through the sea of people. Basically, he would be injured or killed if he touched the halberd. As the halberd swept past, large swaths of enemy troops were crushed.

Their long-range weapons were not idle either. They continuously unleashed their firepower and chased after the direct Beyond Grade As. Their bodies were also covered with electromagnetic, spatial, and other force fields. Once they got close, they would either be frozen in midair or crushed.

This form of the Mechanical Deity was the product of Han Xiao's imitation of SWY-001. It was called (Mechanical Deity — Semi-living Body). With SWY-001 as the blueprint, it was a special transformation technology formed by fusing many abilities. It was the advanced version of the Mechanical Deity, and its various functions were much higher than the normal version.

The prerequisite was not only (Polar Channel Flow — Blood Rage) but also Hella's death energy and Aurora's life energy. Over the years, he had studied the principles and characteristics of these two special energies through the (Energy Analysis) of the Gaud Character Summon Card. He had obtained some results and fused them, which allowed the blood energy to turn into flesh and blood again. At the same time, he did use part of the principles of the Felon technology to successfully balance the symbiotic relationship between the Super cells and the mechanical structure. These flesh and blood tissues greatly increased the output of energy.

However, the reason why it was' Semi-living Body 'was because the functions of the flesh and blood tissues were not complete enough. The ideal state was the model of SWY-001, where the flesh and blood tissues both increased the output of energy and provided energy. It was balanced and perfect, like an independent life form.

However, Han Xiao did not completely replicate this mechanism. The flesh and blood cells that covered the Mechanical Deity only increased the output of energy, but it was very difficult for them to generate energy. This meant that the energy consumption increased, but the upper limit of his mana did not change. The supply broke the balance. He did not know if it was because the flesh and blood of a single person formed some kind of conservation, but he could not reach the state of SWY-001. As a result, the consumption of maintaining (Mechanical Deity — Semi-living Body) was extremely high. Even a peak Beyond Grade A's mana bar could not handle it.

However, Han Xiao's evolution path had reached the peak of the Void System and was already connected to the Void Dimension. Just like Kasuyi, he could borrow the power of the Void. Even if he did not take a beating, he could still absorb an almost infinite amount of mana.

Han Xiao's instantaneous burst of power was too shocking, and the direct Beyond Grade As covered their heads and fled. However, after the initial shock, Clottey and the others gradually adapted to this pressure. The two sides fought fiercely, and it was difficult to tell who had the upper hand.

Clottey and Oulou were both peak Beyond Grade As in the first tier. Their Energy Ranks were definitely over 90,000, and they had received all kinds of enhancements. Although they were not Han Xiao's match in a one-on-one battle, when they worked together, their combat power increased exponentially.

This was especially so when their Esper Abilities were the type of firepower bombardment, so they did not care about the amount of mana they had. They were extremely suitable for this kind of large-scale team battle. Together with their various protective Universal Treasures, they took on more than fifty percent of Han Xiao's firepower.

Furthermore, Clottey and Oulou had a group of strong teammates. They were not the only direct Beyond Grade As whose Energy Ranks were over 70,000. Most of the people guarding the secondary dimension bases were elites, and they usually did not show their faces.

Zi zi zi!

Streaks of plasma arcs of various sizes formed jumping lightning chains and rampaged through the mechanical army, causing massive damage. Guzar was wrapped in bright blue lightning, and he created a lightning storm all by himself. From time to time, he would raise his hands and shoot out countless electromagnetic cannons, which bombarded Han Xiao's protective force field and exploded into sparks.

He was someone who joined the army in the same era as Clottey. Although his potential was not as great as Clottey's, he was still a powerful Beyond Grade A Super. Otherwise, he would not have been sent by the dynasty to guard the secondary dimension outpost all year round.

On the other side, 'Saint' Monan, who was disguised as a monk, flashed through the mechanical army with the help of some kind of phase-shifting Universal Treasure. His punches and kicks were neither fast nor slow, and it was as if they were hitting an invisible barrier. The particles in a large area resonated, causing continuous vibration damage to Han Xiao's mechanical army. Although he was a Pugilist, the large number of Universal Treasures on him made up for many of his shortcomings.

'Army Leader' Padro summoned countless summoned creatures and Alchemy Golems to fight with Han Xiao's mechanical army. There were also many boss-level units that did not care about casualties and crazily restrained Han Xiao's Apostle Weapons. 'Army Flag' Enid continued to activate her ability, providing a large-scale buff to all her allies present.

The thirteen direct Beyond Grade As were not only individually strong, but their teamwork was also very good. Together with their Universal Treasures, they were in a stalemate with Han Xiao for a while and even resisted the pressure of dozens of Apostle Weapons.

Han Xiao's side was not to be outdone either. The Universal Treasures he had built over the years took turns to be used. Even when facing such a luxurious lineup, he was still able to attack and defend.

After sending Clottey flying with his halberd again, Han Xiao glanced at the battlefield and thought quickly.

Although the battlefield was in a stalemate, he was not under much pressure. The main reason was that the threat of his opponents was limited. Although he would not be able to break through the encirclement of these people in a short time, the situation was not dangerous.

He had the absolute advantage in terms of individual strength. As long as he fought them one on one, he would be able to crush them. Be it Clottey or Oulou, neither of them would be able to block his ferocious attacks. However, the others would definitely come up to restrain him and work closely together to resolve this danger.

"Let's start with the weak link first and find a breakthrough."

The essence of a group fight was to catch one person and beat them up. Han Xiao changed his target without hesitation. With a turn of his halberd, he charged toward one of the weaker direct Beyond Grade As.

Seeing this, the other direct Beyond Grade As hurriedly gathered their firepower. Han Xiao was not bothered. Bathed in the cannon fire, the Mechanic Emperor's Sacred Halberd flew up and down, slashing his opponent until they were in a mess.

Boom!

The huge halberd blade smashed down again, and blood suddenly exploded in midair. This direct Beyond Grade A was sent flying and heavily injured.

Han Xiao was about to rush up and finish him off, but the other ten or so people did not care about their injuries and held him back. On the other side, a tractor beam shot out from the main ship of the three Universal Civilizations and sucked the injured away.

The next moment, another three direct Beyond Grade As flew out of the main ship and joined the battle. Han Xiao's opponents suddenly increased to fifteen. The situation returned to a stalemate, and the pressure increased.

Seeing this, Han Xiao's eyes sparkled.

"Adding fuel to the fire?"

He immediately understood the plan of the three Universal Civilizations. They would leave a group of direct Beyond Grade As behind. As long as someone was heavily injured by him, they would immediately bring the injured back for treatment. At the same time, they would send more people to join the battle. This would give the direct Beyond Grade As a chance to rest and recover.

This was equivalent to going up and fighting a few rounds before coming down to rest. Then, someone else would go up and continue fighting, making use of their advantage in numbers. After all, Han Xiao was only one person and could not rest. Meanwhile, the three Universal Civilizations had dozens of direct members, so they had made up their mind to take turns fighting him. They would exhaust him until he ran out of ammunition.

They wanted to win, but they did not want to suffer any casualties.

"Tsk, enough."

Han Xiao curled his lips and did not say anything. After all, there was no rule that said the three Universal Civilizations could not fight like this.

"Since they want to fight a war of attrition, let's see who can last longer."

He shook his head, threw away all distracting thoughts, and focused on the battle.

The two sides fought endlessly. This battle lasted for six days and six nights.

…

The battlefield had been moved many times. The battlefield was filled with mechanical debris and the corpses of summoned creatures. The size of the troops on both sides had shrunk significantly. Be it Han Xiao's Mech Legion or the various direct Beyond Grade As, both sides suffered heavy casualties.

The Mechanical Deity that Han Xiao had transformed into was still fighting fiercely with Clottey and the others. However, in comparison, Han Xiao was still full of energy. Many of the direct Beyond Grade As were already showing signs of fatigue.

The number of direct Beyond Grade As fighting at the same time had increased to twenty-one. After six consecutive days of high-intensity battles, most of them were exhausted, and their condition was constantly deteriorating. Even after more than ten rounds, they still could not hold on much longer.

The news media did not miss a single second, broadcasting everything in real time.

Not many galactic residents could stay in front of the screen, but no matter when they turned on the program, they would still see the scene of the two sides fighting fiercely.

Who knew how many people prayed day and night for Black Star to lose quickly. However, despite being surrounded by such a luxurious lineup, Black Star was still as strong as ever, not showing any signs of losing. Many galactic residents went from shock at the beginning to despair and finally numbness. They stared blankly at the fierce battle on the screen, their minds blank.

What kind of monster is Black Star? Doesn't he know how to get tired?

Seeing that there was no hope of ending the war, even more galactic residents were flustered and exasperated. They racked their brains to attack Han Xiao, as if being strong had become a sin. All their anger, panic, and dissatisfaction found an outlet to vent, venting on Han Xiao. It was as if they were powerless.

The morale of the three Universal Civilizations' soldiers had been getting lower and lower over the past few days. They were shocked out of their wits by Black Star's strength.

Their own upper echelons had given up their pride and attacked him with numbers for a few days. It was already embarrassing enough to fight him one after another, but now, not only were they unable to take him down, they were even killed?

Weren't they still being beaten up?

The Beyond Grade As who were watching the battle from various channels were even more shocked. They knew how difficult it was better than anyone else. It was as if they were seeing Han Xiao for the first time. They were all shocked.

Although they had always known that their president was very strong, this was way too strong!

In the history of Supers, there had never been such an epic battle record. Many Beyond Grade As could only sigh at their inferiority.

The way they saw it, with the strength Black Star displayed, he had probably surpassed all the Beyond Grade As recorded in the history of the explored universe.

"What the f * ck, what the f * ck, is Old Black still human?"

"I finally understand the meaning of the version name … Is this the meaning of the Black Star's era?"

"This is way too strong. Who else is there?"

Compared to the others, the players were the most excited. After watching the action movie for six days, they were already boiling.

No matter what the reactions of the various parties were, the battle still continued.

Clang clang clang!

The halberd danced and chased after one of the direct Beyond Grade As, shattering the other party's shield and causing blood to splatter in midair.

Just as Han Xiao was about to deal the finishing blow, Clottey and Oulou blocked in front of him again. Dark energy and gold energy shot out and clashed with the halberd!

Boom!

A dazzling explosion occurred. Clottey and Oulou retreated with blood spurting out of their mouths. Their injuries worsened again.

At the same time, the heavily damaged Mechanical Emperor's Sacred Halberd finally could not bear the burden anymore. It shattered into pieces and exploded into the sky.

Han Xiao's hands were empty. He looked down and scanned the surroundings. All the direct Beyond Grade As who surrounded him were injured and exhausted.

"Looks like you guys won't be able to last much longer."

Han Xiao clenched his fists and took out a close-combat mechanical weapon that looked like a spear. It was black and gold all over, and the tip of the spear was a hexagonal pyramid. It was also a Universal Treasure that came from Jayz's technology treasure.

Clottey coughed and spat out a mouthful of blood. He forced himself to focus and said, "You don't have many troops left either."

"It's enough. You and Oulou, on the other hand, don't seem to be able to last much longer. The others can take turns, but you guys can't leave. Can you still hold on?"

Han Xiao did not mind.

Clottey was silent. He could not refute.

The other direct members could take turns to rest, but without him or Oulou, the team would definitely not be able to stop Black Star. They would only be destroyed.

Therefore, in the past six days, the two of them had not rested at all. They were covered in wounds. Although they did not lack energy, their injuries were not light. They were almost at the end of their rope.

If only the God's Chosen was willing to help. Unfortunately, he had been watching coldly from the sidelines for the past six days and did not make a move at all. It was as if he was really just there to support them.

There were only two days left until the deadline. The mission given by the higher-ups would probably not be completed …

Just as Clottey decided to give it one last try, a helpless sigh suddenly sounded in the team channel.

This time, a figure flew out from the main ship of the three Universal Civilizations and entered the battlefield.

Everyone turned around, and their expressions changed. It was Wuornos, who had been silent for a few days.

Ignoring his teammates, Wuornos looked up at Han Xiao, shook his head helplessly, and sighed.

"Black Star, although we've only met once, I actually admire you a lot and don't want to fight with you. Unfortunately … I'm still a direct member of the Arcane Church. I can't disobey orders."

Then, ignoring everyone's reaction, Wuornos stretched out his finger and pointed at Han Xiao.

An invisible energy vibrated, and a white-gold light suddenly flew out of the Mechanical Deity's body and entered Wuornos' body.

At this moment, the phantom of a huge Mechanical Deity suddenly appeared from his back.

The next moment, this Mechanical Deity separated from his main body and quickly materialized. It had Wuornos' face, but its appearance was extremely similar to Han Xiao's Mechanical Deity, as if they were twins!
